name: horizontal-reel
title: Horizontal Reel
description: A section pins and vertical scroll pulls a strip of frames sideways, like film through a gate; a frame counter follows.

meta.reducedMotion: The frames become a normal horizontally scrollable row with snap points.
meta.useWhen: Film, gallery, timeline and process concepts with 4–10 frames.
meta.avoidWhen: Content people need to scan quickly; more than one per page; frames that need reading time.
